checker.title: Ntuzi aho wajya?
checker.intro: Subiza ibibazo bike. Tukubwira igihe ukwiye kubonana n'umuganga n'ubwoko bw'ubuvuzi, hanyuma tukakwereka aho wajya hafi yawe.
checker.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kuzana ibibazo. Reba interineti wongere ugerageze.
checker.dangerTitle: Mbere na mbere: hari kimwe muri ibi kiri kuba ubu?
checker.failed: Ntitwashoboye kubona inama ubu. Ongera ugerageze.

service.general_consultation: Isuzumwa risanzwe ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ivuriro.
service.paediatric_consultation: Isuzumwa ry'abana ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ivuriro.
service.antenatal_care: Kwisuzumisha utwite, ku kigo gifite serivisi y'ababyeyi.
service.dermatology: Muganga w'uruhu, cyangwa isuzumwa risanzwe mbere.

reason.pregnancy_warning: Mu gihe utwite, ibi bimenyetso bigomba kurebwa n'umubyaza cyangwa muganga uwo munsi.
reason.infant_illness: Impinja zirwara vuba; umuganga agomba kuzibona uyu munsi.
reason.fever: Umuriro ukeneye gupimwa malariya uwo munsi.
reason.fluid_loss: Gucibwamo no kuruka bishobora gukamya umubiri vuba.
reason.long_cough: Inkorora imaze icyumweru cyangwa irenga igomba gusuzumwa, harimo n'igituntu.
reason.skin: Ibiheri ku ruhu akenshi si ibyihutirwa ariko bikwiye kurebwa.
reason.urine: Kubabara wihagarika akenshi ni indwara ikeneye kuvurwa.
reason.self_care: Ruhuka, unywe amazi kandi ukurikirane. Nibikomera cyangwa bikamara icyumweru, fata gahunda.
reason.safety_age: Ku bana bato cyane n'abasaza, buri gihe tugira inama yo kujya kwa muganga.
reason.safety_duration: Kubera ko bimaze icyumweru, umuganga agomba kubona uruhinja uyu munsi.

checker.selfCareWhen: Jya kwa muganga vuba niba ufite umuriro mwinshi, udashobora kunywa, cyangwa urushijeho kuremba.
checker.notSignedOff: Aya mategeko arimo gusuzumwa n'abaganga mbere y'igerageza.
checker.disclaimer: Iyi ni inama, si isuzuma rya muganga. Niba urembye cyane, jya ku bitaro byihutirwa bikwegereye cyangwa uhamagare 912.
checker.emergencyBody: Hamagara {{number}} cyangwa ujye ku bitaro byihutirwa bikwegereye. Ntutegereze gahunda.

about.title: Ubuvuzi bukwiteguye
about.lead: MediLink ihuza abarwayi mu Rwanda n'ibigo by'ubuvuzi byemejwe: shaka ubuvuzi bwemera ubwishingizi bwawe, fata gahunda cyangwa ujye ku murongo uri kuri telefoni, ugere aho igihe cyawe kigeze.

patients.title: Ku barwayi n'imiryango
patients.body: Shaka ukurikije serivisi, ahantu n'ubwishingizi, urebe uko ikigo cyuzuye, kandi ubike gahunda zawe, imiti n'inyemezabwishyu ahantu hamwe.

facilities.title: Ku bigo by'ubuvuzi
facilities.body: Kora ibyakira abarwayi, umurongo, isuzumwa, farumasi n'ubwishyu muri sisitemu imwe, abarwayi bakakubona.

verified.title: Ibigo byemejwe gusa
verified.body: Buri kigo kigenzurwa hakurikijwe uruhushya rwacyo mbere yo kugaragara kuri MediLink.

rwanda.title: Amakuru yawe aguma mu Rwanda
rwanda.body: Amakuru y'ubuzima arinzwe, abikwa mu Rwanda, kandi afungurwa n'abakuvura gusa. Ushobora kureba uwayafunguye.

about.whoBody: MediLink Rwanda iyobowe na [To confirm]. Aderesi yacu, uko wadusanga n'ushinzwe kurinda amakuru biri hasi.

emergency.title: Mu gihe cy'ibyihutirwa, ntutegereze
emergency.lead: MediLink si iy'ibyihutirwa. Hamagara {{number}} cyangwa ujye ako kanya ku bitaro byihutirwa bikwegereye.

signs.stroke: Gucika intege mu buryo butunguranye ku ruhande rumwe rw'umubiri cyangwa mu maso
signs.pregnancy: Mu gihe utwite: kuva amaraso, kurwara umutwe cyane cyangwa kugagara
signs.baby: Uruhinja rudashobora konka cyangwa kunywa, cyangwa ruruka byose

emergency.goBody: Ibitaro by'akarere n'ibyo kohererezwamo bifite serivisi z'ibyihutirwa amanywa n'ijoro. Ibigo nderabuzima bishobora kugufasha no kukohereza.
emergency.notForBody: Gufata gahunda, kujya ku murongo no kubika amakuru yawe. Ku byihutirwa byose, hamagara cyangwa ujyeyo ubu.

legal.draft: Inyandiko itaranozwa: iri suzumwa n'umunyamategeko mbere yo gutangira. Ibice byanditseho "Bizemezwa" ntibirarangira.

privacy.title: Itangazo ry'ibanga
privacy.summary: Dukusanya gusa ibikenewe mu gutegura no kwandika ubuvuzi bwawe, tubirinda kandi tubibika mu Rwanda, tubyereka abakuvura gusa, kandi ushobora kubireba, kubikosora no kubikuramo.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: The operator of MediLink ([To confirm]) and each health facility that cares for you are responsible for your data, under Law No. 058/2021 on the protection of personal data and privacy.

what.title: What we collect
what.body: Your name, contact details, date of birth, sex, identifiers such as your national ID or insurance number, your bookings and queue tickets, and the records health facilities write about your visits.

why.title: Why we use it
why.body: To find and book care, run the queue, keep your health records, bill and claim insurance, send you reminders, and keep the service safe. We never sell your data or use it for advertising.

where.title: Where it is kept
where.body: On servers in Rwanda, encrypted in transit and at rest. Health records can be opened only by staff at a facility that is caring for you, and every opening is logged.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see who opened your record, download your data, ask for corrections, and close your account. Facilities must keep medical records for the period the law requires.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Medical records are kept as long as the law requires ([To confirm]); other data is deleted or anonymised when no longer needed.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions or complaints: our data protection officer at [To confirm]. You can also contact the National Cyber Security Authority.

terms.title: Amabwiriza yo gukoresha
terms.summary: MediLink igufasha gushaka, gufata gahunda no gukurikirana ubuvuzi. Ubuvuzi butangwa n'ikigo cy'ubuvuzi. MediLink si iy'ibyihutirwa kandi isuzuma ry'ibimenyetso ritanga inama, si isuzuma rya muganga.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Keep your password private. You may manage profiles for your children and people you care for, and share access with others you trust.

bookings.title: Bookings and the queue
bookings.body: Arrive on time or cancel before the deadline. If you arrive late, you are checked in as a walk-in. Bookings you miss without cancelling count as no-shows, and repeated no-shows can limit new bookings for a while.

emergencies.title: Not for emergencies
emergencies.body: In an emergency call 912 or go to the nearest emergency department.

guidance.title: Guidance, not diagnosis
guidance.body: The symptom checker suggests how soon to seek care and which kind. It does not diagnose. Only a clinician can.

facilities.title: Facilities and care
facilities.body: Health facilities are independent and responsible for the care they give, their prices and their records.

fairUse.title: Fair use
fairUse.body: Do not misuse the service, impersonate others or try to access data that is not yours.

law.title: Liability and law
law.body: [To confirm] These terms are governed by the laws of Rwanda.

assistant.title: Tubwire uko wiyumva
assistant.intro: Sobanura uko wiyumva mu magambo yawe. Umufasha akubaza ibibazo bike, hanyuma akakubwira icyo bishobora kuba n’aho wabona muganga.
assistant.testBody: Ntabwo ari isuzuma kandi si iy’ibyihutirwa. Mu igerageza, amagambo yawe yoherezwa kuri serivisi ya AI iri hanze y’u Rwanda: ntwandike izina ryawe, nimero ya telefoni cyangwa indangamuntu.
assistant.kinyarwanda: Ibisubizo mu Kinyarwanda biracyanozwa. Ushobora no kwandika mu Cyongereza cyangwa mu Gifaransa.
assistant.greeting: Muraho. Wumva umeze ute, kandi kuva ryari?
assistant.clarify: Sinabashije kumenya ikimenyetso. Wasobanura uko wiyumva, urugero aho ubabara n’igihe byatangiriye?
assistant.label: Sobanura uko wiyumva
assistant.placeholder: Urugero: mfite umuriro n’umutwe undya kuva ejo

urgency.soon: Jya kwa muganga mu minsi mike

assistant.notDiagnosis: Iri si isuzuma. Muganga ukusuzumye ni we wenyine ushobora kubimenya.
assistant.noPlaces: Nta kigo kiri hafi gitanga iyi serivisi ubu.
assistant.tryIt: Wahitamo kubisobanura mu magambo yawe? Gerageza umufasha wa AI (igerageza)
